name: Software Developer
definition: Designs, writes, tests and maintains application code across the software lifecycle.
disambiguation_notes: Umbrella for developer / programmer / software engineer titles in any language; a technology in the title becomes a tech tag, not a new role. Choose programmer_analyst only when the title says programmer/analyst; frontend_developer for client-side UI only; web_developer for websites/web apps end to end.

name: Programmer Analyst
definition: Combines programming with systems and requirements analysis; a legacy public-sector category.
disambiguation_notes: Pick when the title literally pairs programmer/developer with analyst (Programmer/Analyst, Developer/Programmer Analyst, Software Analyst). Pure coding -> software_developer; no coding -> systems_analyst.

name: Frontend Developer
definition: Builds client-side user interfaces with HTML/CSS/JavaScript frameworks.
disambiguation_notes: Client-side code only. web_developer builds the whole web application; interaction_designer designs but does not code.

name: Web Developer
definition: Builds and maintains websites and web applications end to end.
disambiguation_notes: Full web application including server side. Front-end-only titles -> frontend_developer; web server operations -> web_administrator.

name: Mobile Developer
definition: Builds native or cross-platform mobile applications.
disambiguation_notes: Any mobile platform; iOS/Android/Flutter become tech tag mobile.

name: Integration Developer
definition: Builds APIs, middleware integrations, ESB/iPaaS flows and EDI interfaces.
disambiguation_notes: Writes integration code; middleware_administrator operates the integration platform; integration_architect designs the landscape.

name: Engineering Manager
definition: Manages a software engineering team: people, delivery and technical standards.
disambiguation_notes: Management tier as a role. A hands-on 'Lead Developer' is software_developer at lead_principal; delivery_manager runs delivery without line management.

name: Test Analyst
definition: Plans and executes functional/manual tests, writes test cases and logs defects.
disambiguation_notes: Default for tester / QA analyst / QA engineer titles. Writes automation frameworks -> test_automation_engineer; process quality (standards, audits of deliverables) -> quality_assurance_analyst.

name: Test Automation Engineer
definition: Designs and builds automated test frameworks and scripts.
disambiguation_notes: Title says automation / SDET / test engineer. Manual or unspecified testing -> test_analyst; load/performance -> performance_test_engineer.

name: Performance Test Engineer
definition: Designs and runs load, stress and other non-functional tests.
disambiguation_notes: Non-functional testing only. Web/digital analytics 'performance analyst' is a data role.

name: Test Manager
definition: Leads test teams, strategy, planning and resourcing.
disambiguation_notes: Test coordinator/test lead titles map here (band from evidence). QA/Test Manager combined titles map here.

name: Quality Assurance Analyst
definition: Assures process and deliverable quality against standards; audits and improves quality practices.
disambiguation_notes: Process QA, not software testing. Executes tests -> test_analyst.

name: Data Engineer
definition: Builds and operates data pipelines, warehouses and lakes.
disambiguation_notes: Moves and transforms data at scale. Analytics-layer transformation -> analytics_engineer; database operations -> database_administrator; models -> data_scientist.

name: Data Analyst
definition: Analyses data and produces reports, dashboards and insight for decisions.
disambiguation_notes: Consumes and interprets data. Builds BI platforms/semantic models -> business_intelligence_analyst; statistical/ML modelling -> data_scientist.

name: Business Intelligence Analyst
definition: Builds BI reports, dashboards and semantic models and analyses business trends.
disambiguation_notes: BI developer / BI analyst / report writer titles. General analysis without BI tooling -> data_analyst.

name: Data Scientist
definition: Applies statistics and machine learning to extract insight and build predictive models.
disambiguation_notes: Insight and modelling. Productionising and serving models -> machine_learning_engineer.

name: Analytics Engineer
definition: Transforms warehouse data into tested, documented analytics models (dbt-style).
disambiguation_notes: Sits between data_engineer (pipelines) and data_analyst (consumption).

name: Data Modeler
definition: Designs conceptual, logical and physical data models.
disambiguation_notes: Modelling only. Enterprise data strategy -> data_architect; physical DB platform design -> database_architect.

name: Data Governance Manager
definition: Defines and runs data governance, quality and stewardship.
disambiguation_notes: Governance/stewardship/quality policy. Data privacy compliance -> privacy_specialist.

name: Performance Analyst
definition: Analyses digital service and marketing performance data (web analytics, KPIs, evaluation).
disambiguation_notes: Digital/web analytics and service evaluation, including digital marketing analyst and digital evaluator titles. System performance testing -> performance_test_engineer.

name: Data Migration Specialist
definition: Plans and executes data conversion and migration between systems.
disambiguation_notes: Conversion/migration projects. Ongoing pipelines -> data_engineer.

name: Machine Learning Engineer
definition: Builds, trains, deploys and monitors machine learning models and pipelines.
disambiguation_notes: Engineering of models into production, incl. AI/ML engineer titles. Exploratory modelling -> data_scientist; LLM application building -> ai_engineer; ML platform -> mlops_engineer.

name: AI Engineer
definition: Builds applications on foundation models and AI services (prompting, RAG, agents, evaluation).
disambiguation_notes: Generative-AI application work. Trains/serves classical ML models -> machine_learning_engineer.

name: MLOps Engineer
definition: Builds and operates the ML platform: pipelines, model registry, deployment and monitoring.
disambiguation_notes: Platform for ML. General CI/CD -> devops_engineer.

name: Data & AI Ethicist
definition: Assesses and governs ethical and responsible use of data and AI.
disambiguation_notes: Ethics/responsible-AI assessment. Privacy law compliance -> privacy_specialist.

name: AI Research Scientist
definition: Researches new models, algorithms and methods in AI/ML.
disambiguation_notes: Research, not product engineering. Applied model building -> machine_learning_engineer.

name: Cloud Engineer
definition: Builds and operates cloud infrastructure and platform services.
disambiguation_notes: Hands-on cloud build/run. Designs the cloud landscape -> cloud_architect; on-prem/hybrid servers -> infrastructure_engineer.

name: Infrastructure Engineer
definition: Designs and builds servers, storage, virtualisation and hybrid infrastructure.
disambiguation_notes: Build/engineering. Day-to-day running -> infrastructure_operations_engineer; OS/account administration -> systems_administrator.

name: Infrastructure Operations Engineer
definition: Runs, monitors and maintains infrastructure in live service.
disambiguation_notes: Operations of infrastructure. Building it -> infrastructure_engineer; monitoring batch/jobs from an ops centre -> it_operations_analyst.

name: Systems Administrator
definition: Administers servers, operating systems, accounts and patches.
disambiguation_notes: Sysadmin titles. Network devices -> network_administrator; databases -> database_administrator.

name: Systems Engineer
definition: Engineers and integrates hardware, software and platform components into working systems.
disambiguation_notes: Systems (not software) engineering. Writes application code -> software_developer; requirements analysis -> systems_analyst.

name: DevOps Engineer
definition: Builds CI/CD pipelines, automation and platform tooling bridging development and operations.
disambiguation_notes: Automation/CI-CD focus. Reliability/on-call engineering -> site_reliability_engineer; internal developer platform -> platform_engineer.

name: Site Reliability Engineer
definition: Applies software engineering to availability, latency, performance and incident response.
disambiguation_notes: SRE titles. Pipeline/tooling focus -> devops_engineer.

name: Platform Engineer
definition: Builds and runs internal platforms (PaaS, Kubernetes, developer platforms).
disambiguation_notes: Platform product for engineers. Single-application CI/CD -> devops_engineer.

name: Storage & Backup Engineer
definition: Engineers and operates storage, backup and recovery platforms.
disambiguation_notes: Storage specialism; storage architecture -> infrastructure_architect.

name: Security Analyst
definition: Monitors, triages and investigates security events (SOC/monitoring).
disambiguation_notes: Default for information/cyber/network/data security analyst titles. Builds controls -> security_engineer; assesses policy/risk -> security_grc_analyst.

name: Security Engineer
definition: Designs, implements and maintains security controls and tooling.
disambiguation_notes: Engineering of controls (firewalls, EDR, SIEM, secure design). Monitoring -> security_analyst; designs the security landscape -> security_architect.

name: Penetration Tester
definition: Performs authorised offensive security testing of systems and applications.
disambiguation_notes: Offensive testing. Scanning/tracking vulnerabilities -> vulnerability_analyst.

name: Vulnerability Analyst
definition: Runs vulnerability management: scanning, prioritisation and remediation tracking.
disambiguation_notes: Vulnerability lifecycle. Exploitation testing -> penetration_tester.

name: Security Incident Responder
definition: Detects, contains and remediates security incidents.
disambiguation_notes: Security incidents only. ITSM incident process -> incident_manager.

name: Digital Forensics Analyst
definition: Collects and analyses digital evidence for investigations.
disambiguation_notes: Forensics/eDiscovery. Live incident handling -> incident_responder.

name: Security GRC Analyst
definition: Governance, risk, compliance, policy, audit and assurance for information security.
disambiguation_notes: Policy/risk/assurance work incl. TRA, C&A, audit & assurance. Technical controls -> security_engineer; IT audit generally -> it_auditor.
crosswalk_ddat: Cyber security governance and risk management|Cyber security audit and assurance

name: Security Administrator
definition: Administers security tools, accounts, access and installations.
disambiguation_notes: Operates/administers security systems. Designs them -> security_engineer; identity platforms -> identity_access_management_engineer.

name: Identity & Access Management Engineer
definition: Engineers identity, access, directory and PKI services.
disambiguation_notes: IAM/PKI specialism. General security tooling -> security_engineer.

name: Information Security Manager
definition: Manages the information security function, policies and controls.
disambiguation_notes: Management tier role. Executive accountability -> chief_information_security_officer.

name: IT Auditor
definition: Audits IT systems, controls and processes against standards and risk.
disambiguation_notes: Audit of IT generally. Security-specific assurance -> security_grc_analyst.

name: Privacy Specialist
definition: Assesses privacy impact and data-protection compliance.
disambiguation_notes: Privacy/PIA/data protection. Ethics of AI -> data_ai_ethicist.

name: Enterprise Architect
definition: Defines enterprise-wide technology strategy, standards and target architecture.
disambiguation_notes: Enterprise scope. Single solution -> solution_architect; business capability models -> business_architect.

name: Solution Architect
definition: Designs end-to-end solutions across application, data and infrastructure for a programme or product.
disambiguation_notes: Solution scope incl. GIS system architect titles. Enterprise scope -> enterprise_architect; application internals -> application_architect; technology platform -> technical_architect.

name: Technical Architect
definition: Designs the technical platform and standards a solution is built on.
disambiguation_notes: Platform/technology architecture incl. systems architect and technology architect titles. Application design -> application_architect.

name: Application Architect
definition: Designs the structure and components of application software.
disambiguation_notes: Software/application/web architect titles. Whole-solution scope -> solution_architect.

name: Data Architect
definition: Designs enterprise data structures, flows, standards and information management.
disambiguation_notes: Enterprise data/information management architecture. Physical database platform -> database_architect; modelling only -> data_modeler.

name: Database Architect
definition: Designs database platforms and physical database structures.
disambiguation_notes: Physical DB design. Enterprise data landscape -> data_architect.

name: Security Architect
definition: Designs security architecture, patterns and controls across solutions.
disambiguation_notes: Design authority for security. Implements controls -> security_engineer.

name: Network Architect
definition: Designs network and connectivity architecture.
disambiguation_notes: Design authority for networks. Builds/configures -> network_engineer.

name: Cloud Architect
definition: Designs cloud landing zones, services and migration architecture.
disambiguation_notes: Cloud design authority. Hands-on cloud build -> cloud_engineer.

name: Infrastructure Architect
definition: Designs infrastructure, storage and hosting architecture.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. storage architect and GIS infrastructure architect. Builds it -> infrastructure_engineer.

name: Business Architect
definition: Develops business capability, process and operating-model architecture.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. business transformation architect. Requirements for a system -> business_analyst.

name: Integration Architect
definition: Designs integration and API landscapes.
disambiguation_notes: Design of integration. Builds interfaces -> integration_developer.

name: Project Manager
definition: Plans, runs and reports a project to scope, schedule and budget.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. project lead/leader and task manager titles. Multiple related projects -> program_manager; agile team delivery -> delivery_manager.

name: Program Manager
definition: Directs a programme of related projects toward strategic outcomes.
disambiguation_notes: Programme scope incl. programme delivery manager and project executive. Single project -> project_manager.

name: Delivery Manager
definition: Enables agile team delivery: removes blockers, manages flow, risk and stakeholders.
disambiguation_notes: Agile delivery role. Facilitates ceremonies only -> scrum_master; traditional plan-driven -> project_manager.

name: Scrum Master
definition: Facilitates Scrum events and coaches one or two teams in agile practice.
disambiguation_notes: Team-level facilitation. Organisation-level coaching -> agile_coach.

name: Agile Coach
definition: Coaches teams and leadership in agile ways of working at organisational scale.
disambiguation_notes: Multi-team/organisation coaching. Single team -> scrum_master.

name: Project Coordinator
definition: Supports projects with administration, scheduling, tracking and PMO reporting.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. project administrator, scheduler, PMO analyst. Accountable for delivery -> project_manager.

name: Portfolio Manager
definition: Manages a portfolio of programmes/products: prioritisation, funding and benefits.
disambiguation_notes: Portfolio scope. Programme scope -> program_manager.

name: Risk Management Specialist
definition: Identifies, assesses and manages project and IT delivery risk.
disambiguation_notes: Delivery/IT risk. Security risk -> security_grc_analyst.

name: Project Assurance Reviewer
definition: Independently reviews projects and programmes for health and compliance.
disambiguation_notes: Independent review/assurance. Audits IT controls -> it_auditor.

name: Product Manager
definition: Owns product vision, roadmap and outcomes.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. digital product manager. Backlog ownership for a team -> product_owner; live service ownership -> service_owner.

name: Product Owner
definition: Owns and prioritises a team backlog on behalf of stakeholders.
disambiguation_notes: Team-level backlog. Strategy/roadmap -> product_manager.

name: Service Owner
definition: Accountable for a live digital service end to end.
disambiguation_notes: Service accountability. Product strategy -> product_manager.

name: Business Analyst
definition: Elicits, analyses and documents business requirements and processes.
disambiguation_notes: Default for business analyst, business systems analyst, requirements/functional analyst titles. Specifies technical solutions -> systems_analyst; packaged-platform configuration -> pkg functional consultant.

name: Systems Analyst
definition: Analyses requirements and specifies technical/system solutions.
disambiguation_notes: Systems analyst specifies technical solutions; business_analyst captures business needs. Codes as well -> programmer_analyst.

name: Business Process Analyst
definition: Analyses, re-engineers and improves business processes.
disambiguation_notes: Process re-engineering/improvement, incl. process improvement manager titles. Change adoption -> change_management_consultant.

name: Subject Matter Expert
definition: Provides deep domain/business expertise to a delivery.
disambiguation_notes: Domain expert billed as a role (band usually lead_principal). Titles ending '- SME' on another role are that role at lead_principal.

name: Interaction Designer
definition: Designs user interfaces and interaction flows (UX/UI design).
disambiguation_notes: UX/UI designer titles. Whole-service design -> service_designer; visual assets -> graphic_designer; web page layouts -> web_designer.

name: Service Designer
definition: Designs end-to-end services across channels and touchpoints.
disambiguation_notes: Service-level design. Screen-level -> interaction_designer.

name: User Researcher
definition: Plans and conducts user research to inform design.
disambiguation_notes: Research only. Designs from it -> interaction_designer.

name: Content Designer
definition: Creates and manages user-facing content and web content.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. web content specialist/manager and multimedia content consultant. Content strategy -> content_strategist; technical docs -> technical_writer.

name: Content Strategist
definition: Sets content strategy, standards and governance.
disambiguation_notes: Strategy. Writes content -> content_designer.

name: Graphic Designer
definition: Creates visual design assets and brand-aligned graphics.
disambiguation_notes: Visual/brand assets incl. web graphics designer. Interface behaviour -> interaction_designer.

name: Accessibility Specialist
definition: Assures and advises on accessibility of digital services.
disambiguation_notes: Accessibility only.

name: Technical Writer
definition: Writes technical and user documentation.
disambiguation_notes: Documentation. Web/user content -> content_designer; training material -> learning_content_developer.

name: Web Designer
definition: Designs web page layouts and visuals.
disambiguation_notes: Designs web pages; does not code -> frontend_developer codes them. Brand assets -> graphic_designer.

name: Service Desk Analyst
definition: Provides first/second-line IT support via the service desk.
disambiguation_notes: Help desk / service desk / support specialist titles. Deskside hardware -> desktop_support_technician; application-specific L2/L3 -> application_support_analyst.

name: Desktop Support Technician
definition: Supports, repairs and configures end-user devices and peripherals on site.
disambiguation_notes: Deskside/hardware. Remote first-line -> service_desk_analyst; device engineering -> end_user_computing_engineer.

name: End User Computing Engineer
definition: Engineers end-user device platforms: images, device management, collaboration tools.
disambiguation_notes: EUC engineering. Ticket support -> service_desk_analyst.

name: Application Support Analyst
definition: Supports and operates business applications in live service (L2/L3).
disambiguation_notes: Incl. application operations engineer and product support analyst. Infrastructure -> infrastructure_operations_engineer.

name: IT Operations Analyst
definition: Monitors and operates IT services from an operations/command centre; batch, jobs, alerts.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. operations support specialist, command and control roles. Network-specific NOC -> network_operations_technician.

name: IT Service Manager
definition: Manages ITSM processes and service delivery to agreed levels.
disambiguation_notes: Service management. Runs the service desk -> service_desk_manager.

name: Service Desk Manager
definition: Manages the service desk function.
disambiguation_notes: Management of the desk (incl. help desk manager). Analyst level -> service_desk_analyst.

name: Incident Manager
definition: Owns the ITSM incident process and major incident coordination.
disambiguation_notes: ITSM incidents. Security incidents -> incident_responder.

name: Problem Manager
definition: Owns root-cause analysis and the problem management process.
disambiguation_notes: Problem process only.

name: Change & Release Manager
definition: Owns change, release and configuration management processes.
disambiguation_notes: ITSM change/release/configuration. Organisational change -> change_management_consultant.

name: Service Transition Manager
definition: Manages transition of services into live operation (readiness, acceptance).
disambiguation_notes: Transition/readiness. Steady-state -> it_service_manager.

name: Business Relationship Manager
definition: Manages the relationship between IT and business stakeholders.
disambiguation_notes: IT-to-business liaison. Requirements work -> business_analyst.

name: IT Manager
definition: Manages an IT function or team (generic management tier).
disambiguation_notes: Use when the title is simply IT manager. Specific functions -> engineering_manager, database_manager, it_operations_manager, information_security_manager.

name: IT Operations Manager
definition: Manages IT operations and service delivery teams.
disambiguation_notes: Operations management. Process ownership -> it_service_manager.

name: Business Continuity Specialist
definition: Plans and tests business continuity and disaster recovery.
disambiguation_notes: BC/DR. Security risk -> security_grc_analyst.

name: IT Vendor & Contract Manager
definition: Manages IT contracts, vendor performance and compliance.
disambiguation_notes: Contract/vendor management incl. contract administrator. Sourcing/purchasing -> it_procurement_specialist.

name: IT Procurement Specialist
definition: Sources, evaluates and purchases IT goods and services.
disambiguation_notes: Purchasing. Post-award contract management -> it_vendor_contract_manager.

name: Database Administrator
definition: Installs, secures, tunes, backs up and operates databases.
disambiguation_notes: DBA titles (any engine -> tech tag). Writes database code -> database_developer; designs platforms -> database_architect.

name: Database Analyst
definition: Designs, queries and supports databases and information management.
disambiguation_notes: Between DBA and developer; incl. IM administrator. Pure operations -> database_administrator.

name: Database Developer
definition: Develops stored procedures, SQL/PL-SQL and database-side logic.
disambiguation_notes: Database code. Pipelines -> data_engineer; operations -> database_administrator.

name: Middleware Administrator
definition: Administers application servers, messaging and integration platforms.
disambiguation_notes: Operates middleware. Builds integrations -> integration_developer.

name: Web Administrator
definition: Operates web servers and websites (webmaster).
disambiguation_notes: Incl. webmaster and web manager. Builds sites -> web_developer.

name: Database Manager
definition: Manages the database administration function.
disambiguation_notes: Management tier role.

name: Network Engineer
definition: Designs, implements and maintains network infrastructure.
disambiguation_notes: Build/engineering incl. wireless (tech tag). Day-to-day admin -> network_administrator; design authority -> network_architect; security devices -> security_engineer.

name: Network Administrator
definition: Installs, configures and supports LAN/WAN and network services.
disambiguation_notes: Administration/support. Engineering changes -> network_engineer.

name: Network Analyst
definition: Analyses, monitors and supports network performance and issues.
disambiguation_notes: Incl. network support specialist. Builds networks -> network_engineer.

name: Network Operations Technician
definition: Monitors and troubleshoots networks from a NOC.
disambiguation_notes: NOC roles. General IT ops centre -> it_operations_analyst.

name: Telecommunications Engineer
definition: Designs, installs and maintains voice, data and telecom systems.
disambiguation_notes: Telecom specialist/technician titles. Data networks -> network_engineer.

name: Telecommunications Manager
definition: Manages telecom systems and teams.
disambiguation_notes: Management tier role.

name: Packaged Application Functional Consultant
definition: Configures packaged-platform modules to business processes (ERP/CRM/HCM/ITSM functional consultant/analyst).
disambiguation_notes: Functional/business configuration on a platform (tech tag = platform). Custom code -> packaged_application_developer; technical/basis -> packaged_application_technical_consultant.

name: Packaged Application Developer
definition: Customises and extends packaged platforms in their native languages (ABAP, Apex, etc.).
disambiguation_notes: Platform development. Configuration only -> functional consultant; general software -> software_developer.

name: Packaged Application Technical Consultant
definition: Handles platform technical/basis, integration, performance and upgrades.
disambiguation_notes: Technical platform specialism. Functional config -> functional consultant.

name: Packaged Application Architect
definition: Designs solutions on a packaged platform.
disambiguation_notes: Platform solution architecture. Custom solution architecture -> solution_architect.

name: Packaged Application Administrator
definition: Administers a packaged platform (users, security, releases).
disambiguation_notes: Platform admin. Server/OS admin -> systems_administrator.

name: Management Consultant
definition: Advises on strategy, operating model, process and organisation (incl. HR/OD consulting).
disambiguation_notes: Business/HR/OD/call-centre consultant titles. Technology strategy -> technology_consultant; process re-engineering as analysis -> business_process_analyst. Pyramid grades (Analyst to Senior Manager) are bands of this role, as for technology_consultant.

name: Technology Consultant
definition: Advises on and delivers technology work through a consulting firm's pyramid: Analyst, Consultant, Senior Consultant, Manager, Senior Manager.
disambiguation_notes: The consulting pyramid grades are BANDS of this one role (Kyle, Oct 6, 2026): Analyst = junior, Consultant = intermediate, Senior Consultant and Manager = senior, Senior Manager = lead_principal; Partner/Principal/Director is consulting_director_partner. A practice prefix (IT, Cybersecurity IT, Health IT) is a domain, not a role. Builds systems hands-on -> software_developer etc.; strategy/operating-model advice -> management_consultant.

name: Consulting Director / Partner
definition: Director/partner-level consulting leadership and client accountability.
disambiguation_notes: Top of the consulting pyramid incl. associate director and Partner/Principal/Director labels. Manager and senior manager grades are bands of the consultant roles, not this role.

name: Change Management Consultant
definition: Leads organisational change management and adoption (OCM).
disambiguation_notes: People/adoption change. ITSM change process -> change_release_manager.

name: IT Trainer
definition: Delivers training and instruction on IT systems.
disambiguation_notes: Delivery of training. Builds materials -> learning_content_developer.

name: Learning Content Developer
definition: Designs and builds courseware and training materials.
disambiguation_notes: Courseware/training developer titles. Delivers training -> it_trainer; technical docs -> technical_writer.

name: Communications Specialist
definition: Plans and produces programme/IT communications and marketing materials.
disambiguation_notes: Comms coordinator titles. User-facing service content -> content_designer.

name: Chief Information Officer
definition: Executive accountable for information technology (incl. chief digital and information officer).
disambiguation_notes: Executive tier. Technology strategy officer -> chief_technology_officer.

name: Chief Technology Officer
definition: Executive accountable for technology strategy and engineering.
disambiguation_notes: Executive tier.

name: Chief Data Officer
definition: Executive accountable for data strategy and governance.
disambiguation_notes: Executive tier.

name: Chief Information Security Officer
definition: Executive accountable for information security.
disambiguation_notes: Executive tier. Function management -> information_security_manager.
